people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: “You also, son of man, take a tile, and lay it before yourself, and portray on it a city, even Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: “Now you, son of man, take a brick, place it before you, and draw on it the city of Jerusalem.
